title: cananga brandisiana
intro: Cananga brandisiana, commonly known as ylang-ylang, is a flowering plant in the custard apple family native to the Philippines and Indonesia. This plant is valued for its fragrant flowers, which are used in perfumes, aromatherapy, and traditional medicine, offering various health benefits such as stress relief, anxiety reduction, and improved sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of ylang-ylang include its sedative, antidepressant, and antiseptic properties, making it useful for wound care and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of Cananga brandisiana include sesquiterpenes, phenolic acids, and esters, which contribute to its medicinal properties and fragrance.
